title: Tang Ancestral Hall (Ha Tsuen)
geometryBasis: Official Lands Department building polygon, published HKPD base and roof heights, the original local five-metre DTM, one exact cleared Qualla exterior photograph and AMO hall and restoration records.
sectionBasis: The three timber-roofed halls stand in axial sequence with open courts between them. The lower columns are stone and the walls gray masonry. The low drum platforms flank the protected central entry, and two side chambers occupy the last courtyard.
limitations: The 2007 cleared photograph controls the original entry and roof proportions. The restoration facts and official terrain and height measurements set the standing model. The precise ridge relief and rear ornament use simplified geometry.
